story.titleZh: 勒克莱尔：巴库结果不理想但已竭尽全力，马来西亚见
story.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔发帖表示已离开巴库，比赛结果虽不理想但车队已发挥出全部实力，全队将继续全力冲刺，力争回到目标位置，并预告下一站马来西亚见。

story.originalTitle: Back from Baku, not the result we wanted but we maximised what we had. We keep pushing flat out to be back where we want to be. See you in Malaysia �...
story.summaryEn:
Back from Baku, not the result we wanted but we maximised what we had. 
We keep pushing flat out to be back where we want to be. See you in Malaysia 🇲🇾
detailZh: （勒克莱尔发帖）"巴库之行结束了，结果不是我们想要的，但我们已经把现有条件发挥到了极致。我们会继续全力以赴，争取回到我们想要的位置。马来西亚见 🇲🇾"
detailEn:
Back from Baku, not the result we wanted but we maximised what we had. 
We keep pushing flat out to be back where we want to be. See you in Malaysia 🇲🇾
